_why: The premade build takes none of the three talents the Alonecraft Affliction
redesign is built on, so a solo affliction warlock currently runs a rotation
with nothing under it. This build buys all three plus the talent that makes
the drains worth pressing:
Fel Interdiction 1/1  (T7.3) defers half of every hit taken under Fel
Armor into Mark of Gul'dan, a 10-stack self-DoT
bleeding the pool back over 10 seconds. This is the
whole loop; without it there is nothing to clear.
Malfeasance 2/2       (T8.3) widens the clearing path from Drain Soul
alone to Drain Life, Shadow Bolt and Haunt, gives
periodic damage a 40% chance to clear a stack, and
makes Soulshatter clear four. Without it the only
way to spend the bar is a channel the rotation has
no other reason to cast.
Fel Concentration 3/3 (T2.1) 30% damage reduction for the duration of a
Drain Soul or Drain Life channel. This is what turns
clearing a stack into active mitigation rather than
a damage loss.
Improved Drain Soul 2/2 (T1.1) shard generation 20% -> 40%. Drain Soul is
a rotational filler here rather than an execute, so
this runs constantly.
Siphon Life 1/1 is already in the premade build and is load-bearing for the
same loop: it heals for 15% of ALL shadow damage under Alonecraft, not just
Corruption's.
Funded by three things that need someone else, or somewhere else:
Improved Felhunter 2/2  pet mana and health regeneration. Two points of
upkeep on a pet that is not the damage source.
Grim Reach 1/2          affliction range. A solo warlock chooses its own
engagement distance.
Ruin 5/5                the Destruction dip's crit-damage talent. It
raises critical strike damage of Destruction
spells, which out of this build's kit is Shadow
Bolt and nothing else -- Affliction's throughput
is periodic, and periodic damage does not crit.
Improved Shadow Bolt and Bane stay.
61 Affliction / 10 Destruction.
